description_en: Queries the list of protected objects for which API security protection is enabled
description_zh: 查询API安全防护对象生效列表
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-apisec-protection-resources --instance-id waf-cn-0xldbqt0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeApisecProtectionResources

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the protected object
parameters.name: resource

parameters.help_en: The page number to return when you perform a paged query. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page. For more information about paging, see the API reference
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为1，表示返回第1页数据
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page when you perform a paged query. Default value: 10, which indicates 10 entries per page. For more information about paging, see the API reference
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为10，表示每页包含10条结果
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The global switch for API security
parameters.name: apisec_status

The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland

WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
